fireBolt.name: Fire Bolt
fireBolt.rules: Ranged spell attack, 120ft. Hit: 1d10 fire damage (scales with character level: 2d10 at 5th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 17th).

sacredFlame.name: Sacred Flame
sacredFlame.rules: Target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage. No cover benefit against this spell. Scales like Fire Bolt.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.rules: Touch a willing creature; it can add 1d4 to one ability check of its choice before the spell ends (concentration, 1 minute).

magicMissile.name: Magic Missile
magicMissile.rules: Three darts of force, each dealing 1d4+1 damage, automatically hit (no attack roll or save). One extra dart per slot level above 1st.

cureWounds.name: Cure Wounds
cureWounds.rules: Touch a creature; it regains 1d8 + spellcasting ability modifier HP. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

shieldSpell.name: Shield
shieldSpell.rules: Reaction when hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until the start of your next turn (retroactively can turn a hit into a miss), and immune to Magic Missile.

healingWord.name: Healing Word
healingWord.rules: Bonus action, 60ft range. Target regains 1d4 + spellcasting ability modifier HP. +1d4 per slot level above 1st.

burningHands.name: Burning Hands
burningHands.rules: 15-foot cone. Each creature makes a Dexterity save: 3d6 fire damage on a failure, half as much on a success.
